title: Corrupt MC
description: Tired of safe, hand-holding SMPs? So were we. No protections, no shop, almost complete chaos.
body:
CorruptMC – Semi-Anarchy Chaos

Tired of safe, hand-holding SMPs? So were we.

Welcome to CorruptMC — a Java + Bedrock (Geyser) semi-anarchy server built for players who want real chaos… just with a few rules to keep it playable.

This isn’t your typical claim-protected, hug-your-neighbor SMP.

What We Offer:

• Near full in-game freedom  
• No land claims — defend your base… or lose it  
• Player-driven conflicts & alliances  
• Events (starting soon) hosted by our Community Manager  
• Friendly but chaos-encouraging staff  
• Active, growing community
